Can your crew restore power before the delivery trucks pull up to the gate?

audio_script.text_en: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this update on the Solaris portable water purifier. Last week, our external testing lab in Zurich completed the durability trials on the ceramic filter cartridge.

While the filtration purity exceeded ninety-nine point nine percent, the plastic latch on the outer housing cracked after three hundred drop cycles. Now, we certainly don't want outdoor hikers dealing with a loose cover on the trail.
Therefore, our mechanical engineering team has redesigned the latch using reinforced nylon, which adds only twelve cents per unit to our manufacturing cost and keeps us well within budget.
Modified molds have already been sent to the injection-molding plant, and we will review the new prototype samples at our Friday morning meeting.

evidence.quote_en: offered the most ____ rates for recycled cardboard

items.explanation_zh: 定冠詞與最高級副詞 the most 後方、名詞 rates 前方須填入形容詞，表達「最具競爭力的報價（the most competitive rates）」，故選 (B) competitive。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: compete 為動詞，不可置於 the most 與名詞 rates 之間。
competitively 為副詞，不可直接修飾名詞 rates。
competitor 為名詞「競爭對手」，不可與 the most 連用修飾 rates。

vocabulary.note_zh: primary supplier 指主要供應商。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 時間與條件連接詞 once（一旦…就…）連接完成升級後之自動同步。

items.prompt_en: ____ the cloud backup patch is installed on the main server, all regional workstations will synchronize automatically.

choices.text_en: Once
During
Despite
Unless

evidence.quote_en: ____ the cloud backup patch is installed on the main server, all regional workstations will synchronize automatically

items.explanation_zh: 從屬子句「雲端備份修補程式安裝於主伺服器上」為觸發主句「所有區域工作站將自動同步」之時間／條件起點，(A) Once（一旦…）為連接詞且語意完全契合。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: During 為介系詞，後方不可接完整子句。
Despite 為介系詞，後方不可接完整子句且語意無讓步轉折。
Unless 意為「除非」，若填入則變成「除非安裝修補程式，否則將會自動同步」，與常理相反。

vocabulary.note_zh: security/backup patch 指修補更新檔。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 省略 if 之第三類／混合條件句或 should 萬一條件倒裝（Should any discrepancy arise...）。

items.prompt_en: ____ any discrepancy arise between the translated summary and the original contract, the English text shall prevail.

choices.text_en: Should
Were
Had
Would

evidence.quote_en: ____ any discrepancy arise between the translated summary and the original contract, the English text shall prevail

items.explanation_zh: 從屬子句主詞 any discrepancy 為單數，後方動詞卻為原形動詞 arise，且主句使用未來法務規定助動詞 shall prevail，屬於省略 if 之未來假設倒裝句（= If any discrepancy should arise... -> Should any discrepancy arise...），故選 (A) Should。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: Were 倒裝搭配單數主詞時，後方須接不定詞 to arise（Were any discrepancy to arise），不可直接接原形動詞 arise。
Had 倒裝表過去相反假設，後方須接過去分詞 arisen。
Would 不用於條件從屬子句句首倒裝。

vocabulary.note_zh: the English text shall prevail 指以英文文本為準。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 企業內部專業證照補助政策通知，涵蓋詞性、時態語態、連接詞與插句。

blocks.text_en:
Kestrel BioLabs encourages full-time staff members to pursue industry certifications that strengthen their technical capabilities. Under our updated Tuition Assistance Policy, employees who have completed at least one year of continuous service may apply for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-1]] of up to $1,500 per calendar year.

Eligible expenses include accredited examination fees and required digital study materials. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-2]] Applications must be endorsed by a department director at least three weeks before the course start date.

Once the certification exam has been passed, the employee should upload the official score certificate and itemized payment receipts to the HR portal. Approved claims [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-3]] in the employee's next regular direct-deposit paycheck. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-4]], staff members who leave the company voluntarily within six months of receiving funds must repay the subsidized amount in full.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-1]].

choices.text_en: reimburse
reimbursed
reimbursement
reimbursing

evidence.quote_en: may apply for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-1]] of up to $1,500 per calendar year.

items.explanation_zh: 介系詞 for 後方且接續介系詞片語 of up to $1,500，須填入名詞作受詞；apply for reimbursement of up to $1,500（申請最高 1,500 美元之費用補助／報銷）為標準搭配，故選名詞 (C) reimbursement。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: reimburse 為原形動詞，不可作介系詞 for 之受詞。
reimbursed 為過去分詞，不可作介系詞受詞。
動名詞 reimbursing 若作及物動詞需接直接受詞而非 of up to $1,500。

vocabulary.note_zh: pursue certifications 指考取專業證照。

items.prompt_en: Select the best sentence for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-2]].

choices.text_en: Travel and hotel costs for out-of-town test centers are not covered under this plan.
The company cafeteria will introduce a new summer menu next Monday.
All laboratory microscopes were calibrated by an external vendor in August.
Entry-level interns are automatically enrolled in the executive bonus pool.

evidence.quote_en: Eligible expenses include accredited examination fees and required digital study materials. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-2]] Applications must be endorsed by a department director

items.explanation_zh: 前句界定符合補助資格之費用項目（認證考試報名費與必備數位教材），(A)「前往外地考場之差旅與住宿費用不在本計畫補助範圍內」緊接著補充說明排除項目，使費用範圍界定完整。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 員工餐廳夏季菜單與證照補助政策無關。
實驗室顯微鏡校正與人資進修補助無關。
實習生高階獎金池與本段證照費用申請規範無關。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 經官方認可的、合格認證的

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-3]].

choices.text_en: disbursed
will be disbursed
have disbursed
disbursing

evidence.quote_en: Approved claims [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-3]] in the employee's next regular direct-deposit paycheck.

items.explanation_zh: 主詞 Approved claims（核准的報銷申請款項）為承受「撥付（disburse）」動作之物，且發放時間為未來下一期薪資轉帳（next regular direct-deposit paycheck），故選未來被動式 (B) will be disbursed。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: disbursed 為過去式主動或分詞，與 next regular paycheck 時間及被動語態不合。
have disbursed 為現在完成主動式，款項無法主動撥付。
disbursing 為分詞，缺少助動詞無法作為句子主要動詞。

vocabulary.note_zh: direct-deposit paycheck 指薪資轉帳款。

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-4]].

choices.text_en: However
Similarly
Therefore
For example

evidence.quote_en: Approved claims [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-3]] in the employee's next regular direct-deposit paycheck. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000301-4]], staff members who leave the company voluntarily within six months of receiving funds must repay the subsidized amount in full.

items.explanation_zh: 前句說明核准款項將於下期薪資中撥付，本句轉而提出但書限制「然而，若員工於領取補助後六個月內自願離職，必須全額退還補助款」，構成轉折但書關係，故選 (A) However。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: Similarly 表「同樣地」，前後並非相似類比。
Therefore 表「因此」，領取薪資撥款並非離職須還款的因果推論。
For example 表舉例，離職追回條款並非正常薪資撥付的例子。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 單篇商務供應商請款與早鳥折扣電子郵件，考核細節與推論。

documents.title_en: Subject: Invoice #INV-8842 — Acoustic Wall Panels for Conference Wing

blocks.text_en:
To: Accounts Payable <ap@veridianarchitects.com>
From: Billing Department <billing@nordicacoustics.se>
Date: October 3
Subject: Invoice #INV-8842 — Acoustic Wall Panels

Dear Veridian Architects Team,

Attached is Invoice #INV-8842 for the forty custom oak acoustic wall panels delivered and installed in your third-floor conference wing on October 1. The total balance due is $12,400, payable within 30 calendar days.

As a reminder, commercial clients who remit full payment via electronic wire transfer within 10 days of the invoice date (by October 13) may deduct a 3 percent early-settlement discount ($372) from the invoice total. Please include the invoice number in the wire reference field so our accounting system can credit your account promptly.

items.prompt_en: What is the purpose of the e-mail?

choices.text_en: To request payment for recently installed sound-absorbing panels
To reschedule the delivery of forty oak conference tables
To confirm receipt of a wire transfer sent on October 1
To provide a price quote for renovating a building lobby

evidence.quote_en: Attached is Invoice #INV-8842 for the forty custom oak acoustic wall panels delivered and installed in your third-floor conference wing on October 1. The total balance due is $12,400

items.explanation_zh: 信件隨函附上 10 月 1 日已交貨並安裝於三樓會議區之 40 片客製橡木隔音吸音牆板（acoustic wall panels）請款發票，並說明應付總額與付款期限，故目的為請求支付近期安裝之隔音牆板款項 (A)。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 標的物為 40 片橡木吸音牆板（acoustic wall panels）且已於 10 月 1 日安裝完畢，並非會議桌改期交貨。
款項尚未支付（The total balance due is $12,400），10 月 1 日為交貨安裝日。
此為完工後之正式請款發票而非大廳裝修報價單。

items.prompt_en: How can Veridian Architects reduce the amount it owes by $372?

choices.text_en: By returning unused mounting brackets to the warehouse
By paying the full balance via wire transfer on or before October 13
By signing a two-year maintenance contract for the third floor
By mailing a paper check within 30 calendar days

evidence.quote_en: commercial clients who remit full payment via electronic wire transfer within 10 days of the invoice date (by October 13) may deduct a 3 percent early-settlement discount ($372) from the invoice total.

items.explanation_zh: 第二段明載：商業客戶若於發票日起 10 天內（即 10 月 13 日前）透過電子電匯（electronic wire transfer）付清全額，即可從發票總額扣除 3% 早鳥結清折扣（$372），故選 (B)。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 未提及退還安裝支架。
未提及簽署兩年維護合約。
須於 10 天內以電子電匯付款才享有折扣，30 天是一般付款期限且未提紙本支票折扣。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 提早結清折扣、早鳥付款折扣
vocabulary.note_zh: 應收應付帳款常見術語。
